description: The bar chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks” illustrates accuracy results for three methods across two evaluation tasks. The horizontal axis contains the task categories “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval,” arranged left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.7 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For each task, three adjacent bars are shown corresponding to the legend: “Base” (brown), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (green), and “RMU” (tan). In the “MCQ Eval” group, the brown Base bar reaches 0.644 (value annotated above the bar), the green RMU with Enhanced GCG bar reaches 0.539, and the tan RMU bar reaches 0.299. In the “Generation Eval” group, the brown Base bar reaches 0.597, the green RMU with Enhanced GCG bar reaches 0.263, and the tan RMU bar reaches 0.106. The bars are grouped by task rather than sorted by value, and each bar has a numeric label placed above it; no additional highlighting, stacking, or special emphasis is shown beyond the distinct colors and legend.
